rule: DATA_EXISTENCE != TRAINING_AUTHORITY; prior evaluation/world-contact authority is not silently converted into training supervision.

known_assets.prior_role: P47 public historical world-contact / representation transport source
known_assets.reason: Using prior world-contact source for training would change its evidential role and can contaminate transport claims. A prospectively disjoint derivative may be opened only with an explicit role split.

known_assets.prior_role: private AI-Hub / structured Korean custody used under prior private-data firewall
known_assets.reason: No external-compute export or training use is authorized by P50 merely because bytes exist.
Preserve evaluation authority unless an exact non-overlapping train split and license role are prospectively sealed.

known_assets.prior_role: human-anchor, query-group holdout, operator-induction and revision-surface evidence
known_assets.reason: Held-out human anchors and future PIA/evaluation items may not become training labels.

known_assets.prior_role: authority, compiler, generation and revision evidence
known_assets.reason: Human rewrite/action and KSGT compiler output retain typed authority ceilings; neither is universal correctness supervision.

required_before_any_training: contamination check against P47/P48/P49 and planned P50 evaluation IDs
tokenizer training manifest separated from evaluation role
training token budget and deduplication policy
